sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant CLI as "cli.py"
    participant Service as "service.py"
    participant Storage as "storage.py"
    participant Model as "models.py"
    User ->> CLI: todo add "New Task"
    CLI ->> Service: create_task("New Task")
    Service ->> Model: Task("description='New Task'")
    Model -->> Service: Task Object
    Service ->> Storage: save_tasks("collection")
    Storage -->> Service: Success
    Service -->> CLI: Task Created
    CLI -->> User: "Task added successfully"
    User ->> CLI: todo list --json
    CLI ->> Service: get_all_tasks()
    Service ->> Storage: load_tasks()
    Storage -->> Service: List of Tasks
    Service -->> CLI: Task Collection
    CLI ->> Model: serialize_to_json("collection")
    Model -->> CLI: JSON String
    CLI -->> User: [JSON Output]
